title: Airport Weather
description: Pick an airport on the map, or from the list, to see its observed weather (METARs) over time: flight category, cloud layers, visibility, present weather, wind, temperature and pressure.

panels.title: Airports
panels.description: Each airport with weather data, coloured by the flight category of its latest report in the time range: VFR green, MVFR blue, IFR red, LIFR magenta. The selected airport is the yellow star. Click an airport, then "Show this airport", to see its weather below.

targets.rawSql:
-- Each airport's latest report in the time range, as a flight category.
SELECT a.airport AS airport, a.airport_name AS Name, a.lat AS lat, a.lon AS lon,
       w.category AS `Flight category`, formatDateTime(w.last, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%iZ') AS `Last report`
FROM (
    SELECT station, last,
           arrayFilter((l, c) -> c IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV') AND l IS NOT NULL,
                       [r.5, r.6, r.7, r.8], [r.1, r.2, r.3, r.4]) AS layers,
           if(empty(layers), NULL, arrayMin(layers)) AS ceiling,
           multiIf(r.9 IS NULL AND ceiling IS NULL AND r.1 = '', NULL,
                   ceiling < 500 OR r.9 < 1, 'LIFR',
                   ceiling < 1000 OR r.9 < 3, 'IFR',
                   ceiling <= 3000 OR r.9 <= 5, 'MVFR', 'VFR') AS category
    FROM (
        SELECT station, max(valid) AS last,
               argMax((skyc1, skyc2, skyc3, skyc4, skyl1, skyl2, skyl3, skyl4, vsby), valid) AS r
        FROM faa.weather WHERE $__timeFilter(valid)
        GROUP BY station
    )
) AS w
INNER JOIN faa.airport_station AS a ON a.station = w.station
SELECT airport, airport_name AS Name, lat, lon FROM faa.airport_station WHERE airport = '${airport}' LIMIT 1

panels.title: Flight category
panels.description: FAA flight category of the latest report in the time range. VFR: ceiling above 3,000 ft and visibility above 5 mi; MVFR: ceiling 1,000-3,000 ft or visibility 3-5 mi; IFR: ceiling 500-999 ft or visibility 1-3 mi; LIFR: ceiling below 500 ft or visibility below 1 mi.

targets.rawSql:
WITH arrayFilter((l, c) -> c IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV') AND l IS NOT NULL,
                   [skyl1, skyl2, skyl3, skyl4], [skyc1, skyc2, skyc3, skyc4]) AS layers,
     if(empty(layers), NULL, arrayMin(layers)) AS ceiling,
     multiIf(vsby IS NULL AND ceiling IS NULL AND skyc1 = '', NULL,
             ceiling < 500 OR vsby < 1, 'LIFR',
             ceiling < 1000 OR vsby < 3, 'IFR',
             ceiling <= 3000 OR vsby <= 5, 'MVFR', 'VFR') AS category
SELECT category AS `Flight category`
FROM faa.weather FINAL WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid)
ORDER BY valid DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Wind
panels.description: Latest wind: direction it blows from (degrees true), speed and gusts in knots.

targets.rawSql:
WITH arrayFilter((l, c) -> c IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV') AND l IS NOT NULL,
                   [skyl1, skyl2, skyl3, skyl4], [skyc1, skyc2, skyc3, skyc4]) AS layers,
     if(empty(layers), NULL, arrayMin(layers)) AS ceiling,
     multiIf(vsby IS NULL AND ceiling IS NULL AND skyc1 = '', NULL,
             ceiling < 500 OR vsby < 1, 'LIFR',
             ceiling < 1000 OR vsby < 3, 'IFR',
             ceiling <= 3000 OR vsby <= 5, 'MVFR', 'VFR') AS category
SELECT if(sknt = 0, 'Calm', concat(ifNull(leftPad(toString(toUInt16(drct)), 3, '0'), 'VRB'), '° ',
       toString(toUInt16(sknt)), ifNull(concat('G', toString(toUInt16(gust))), ''), ' kt')) AS `Wind`
FROM faa.weather FINAL WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid)
ORDER BY valid DESC LIMIT 1

panels.description: Latest temperature and dew point. A spread of a few degrees or less favours fog and low cloud.

targets.rawSql:
WITH arrayFilter((l, c) -> c IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV') AND l IS NOT NULL,
                   [skyl1, skyl2, skyl3, skyl4], [skyc1, skyc2, skyc3, skyc4]) AS layers,

SELECT concat(toString(round(tmpf)), ' / ', toString(round(dwpf)), ' °F') AS `Temp / dew point`
FROM faa.weather FINAL WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid)
ORDER BY valid DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Sky
panels.description: Cloud layers in the latest report, lowest first (– if none): ◔ few (1-2 eighths), ◑ scattered (3-4), ◕ broken (5-7), ● overcast, ⊗ sky obscured (vertical visibility); heights in feet above ground.

targets.rawSql:
WITH arrayFilter((l, c) -> c IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV') AND l IS NOT NULL,
                   [skyl1, skyl2, skyl3, skyl4], [skyc1, skyc2, skyc3, skyc4]) AS layers,
     if(empty(layers), NULL, arrayMin(layers)) AS ceiling,
     multiIf(vsby IS NULL AND ceiling IS NULL AND skyc1 = '', NULL,
             ceiling < 500 OR vsby < 1, 'LIFR',
             ceiling < 1000 OR vsby < 3, 'IFR',
             ceiling <= 3000 OR vsby <= 5, 'MVFR', 'VFR') AS category
SELECT nullIf(arrayStringConcat(arrayFilter(x -> x IS NOT NULL,
       [multiIf(skyc1 IN ('', 'CLR'), NULL,
               concat(transform(skyc1, ['FEW', 'SCT', 'BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'],
                                ['◔ FEW', '◑ SCT', '◕ BKN', '● OVC', '⊗ VV'], skyc1),
                      ifNull(concat(' ', toString(toUInt32(skyl1)), ' ft'), ''))),
        multiIf(skyc2 IN ('', 'CLR'), NULL,
               concat(transform(skyc2, ['FEW', 'SCT', 'BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'],
                                ['◔ FEW', '◑ SCT', '◕ BKN', '● OVC', '⊗ VV'], skyc2),
                      ifNull(concat(' ', toString(toUInt32(skyl2)), ' ft'), ''))),
        multiIf(skyc3 IN ('', 'CLR'), NULL,
               concat(transform(skyc3, ['FEW', 'SCT', 'BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'],
                                ['◔ FEW', '◑ SCT', '◕ BKN', '● OVC', '⊗ VV'], skyc3),
                      ifNull(concat(' ', toString(toUInt32(skyl3)), ' ft'), ''))),
        multiIf(skyc4 IN ('', 'CLR'), NULL,
               concat(transform(skyc4, ['FEW', 'SCT', 'BKN', 'OVC', 'VV'],
                                ['◔ FEW', '◑ SCT', '◕ BKN', '● OVC', '⊗ VV'], skyc4),
                      ifNull(concat(' ', toString(toUInt32(skyl4)), ' ft'), '')))]), '   '), '') AS `Sky`
FROM faa.weather FINAL WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid)
ORDER BY valid DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Cloud layers
panels.description: Each reported cloud layer (skyc1-4 at heights skyl1-4) as a dot at its height in feet above ground, one per report; layer 1 is always the lowest. The scale stops at 35,000 ft: the few higher reports are almost all typing errors in the METAR. Colour shows the cover, cool to warm as it increases: ◔ few (1-2 eighths of the sky) blue, ◑ scattered (3-4) green, ◕ broken (5-7) yellow, ● overcast orange; ⊗ sky obscured purple, with vertical visibility as the height. Clear sky has no layer. The lowest broken, overcast or obscured layer is the ceiling; the bands behind show the flight category it alone would give: LIFR below 500 ft, IFR below 1,000, MVFR to 3,000.

panels.title: Low cloud
panels.description: The same cloud layers below 5,000 ft, where the ceiling decides whether flights operate under visual or instrument rules; higher layers are off the top. Colour shows the cover, cool to warm as it increases: ◔ few (1-2 eighths of the sky) blue, ◑ scattered (3-4) green, ◕ broken (5-7) yellow, ● overcast orange; ⊗ sky obscured purple, with vertical visibility as the height. Clear sky has no layer. The lowest broken, overcast or obscured layer is the ceiling; the bands behind show the flight category it alone would give: LIFR below 500 ft, IFR below 1,000, MVFR to 3,000.

panels.title: Visibility
panels.description: Visibility in statute miles (10 = 10 or more). Bands: below 1 mi LIFR, 1-3 IFR, 3-5 MVFR.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT valid AS time, vsby AS Visibility
FROM faa.weather FINAL WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Temperature and dew point
panels.description: Temperature and dew point, °F. Where the lines meet, the air is saturated: expect fog, mist or low cloud. The dotted line is freezing.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT valid AS time, tmpf AS Temperature, dwpf AS `Dew point`
FROM faa.weather FINAL WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Present weather
panels.description: Most significant weather in each report: ⛈ thunderstorm, 🧊 freezing rain or drizzle, ❄ snow, sleet or hail, 🌧 rain or showers, 🌦 drizzle, 🌫 fog, ≡ mist, haze, smoke or dust. The second row is the METAR code: - light, + heavy, VC in the vicinity, SH showers, BL blowing.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT valid AS time, multiIf(match(wxcodes, 'TS'), '⛈ Thunderstorm',
               match(wxcodes, 'FZ(RA|DZ)'), '🧊 Freezing rain',
               match(wxcodes, 'SN|SG|PL|GS|GR'), '❄ Snow / ice',
               match(wxcodes, 'RA|SH'), '🌧 Rain',
               match(wxcodes, 'DZ'), '🌦 Drizzle',
               match(wxcodes, 'FG'), '🌫 Fog',
               match(wxcodes, 'BR|HZ|FU|DU|SA'), '≡ Mist / haze',
               wxcodes != '', '? Other', NULL) AS Weather, nullIf(wxcodes, '') AS Codes
FROM faa.weather FINAL WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Wind direction
panels.description: Arrows point the way the wind blows; the letters say where it blows from (↓ N is a north wind).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT valid AS time, multiIf(sknt IS NULL, NULL, sknt = 0, '○ Calm', drct IS NULL, '↻ Variable',
               ['↓ N', '↙ NE', '← E', '↖ SE', '↑ S', '↗ SW', '→ W', '↘ NW'][intDiv(toUInt16(drct + 22.5) % 360, 45) + 1]) AS `Wind from`
FROM faa.weather FINAL WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid) ORDER BY time

SELECT valid AS time, sknt AS Wind, gust AS Gusts
FROM faa.weather FINAL WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Precipitation and pressure
panels.description: Precipitation since the last hourly report, inches (bars; a trace shows as 0.0001), and altimeter setting, inHg (line, right axis). A falling altimeter usually means a low and worse weather approaching.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT valid AS time, p01i AS `Precipitation`, alti AS Altimeter
FROM faa.weather FINAL WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Reports (METARs)
panels.description: Every report in the time range, newest first, as transmitted. Routine reports are issued hourly; specials (SPECI) when conditions change.

targets.rawSql:
WITH arrayFilter((l, c) -> c IN ('BKN', 'OVC', 'VV') AND l IS NOT NULL,
                   [skyl1, skyl2, skyl3, skyl4], [skyc1, skyc2, skyc3, skyc4]) AS layers,
     if(empty(layers), NULL, arrayMin(layers)) AS ceiling,
     multiIf(vsby IS NULL AND ceiling IS NULL AND skyc1 = '', NULL,
             ceiling < 500 OR vsby < 1, 'LIFR',
             ceiling < 1000 OR vsby < 3, 'IFR',
             ceiling <= 3000 OR vsby <= 5, 'MVFR', 'VFR') AS category
SELECT formatDateTime(valid, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%iZ') AS `Time (UTC)`, category AS `Flight category`, metar AS METAR
FROM faa.weather FINAL WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(valid)
ORDER BY valid DESC LIMIT 2000
